---
name: Feature request
about: Something Meshware should do that it does not
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**The problem**

What you are trying to do, and where Meshware gets in the way today. A problem is more useful
to us than a solution: there may be a way to do it already, or a better shape for it.

**What you would like to happen**

The commands you would type, or the configuration you would write, and what you would expect
back.

**What you do now instead**

The workaround, if there is one, and what it costs you.

**Before you open this**

- [ ] I searched the existing issues.
- [ ] I read [limits.md](https://github.com/neuralpunk/meshware/blob/main/docs/operating/limits.md),
      which lists what Meshware deliberately does not do.
